# A refilled with 500.00 USD from C at 1.40, which repays what A owes.
#
# C's 500.00 leave the held side, drawn from C's cost basis at 1.30: 650.00 of
# cost, used at 1.40, realizes 50.00. A's 500.00 owed leaves the owed side,
# drawn from A's cost basis at 1.35: a debt of 675.00 paid off with dollars
# worth 700.00, which realizes −25.00. Each split is valued at the cost of the
# cost basis it gives, and `$residual$` takes the 25.00 between them.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Refill A with 500.00 USD from C"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-650.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000003"
	Assets:USD A 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "675.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000001"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
